name: acceptance-gate
description: Codex-native acceptance gate for AI-generated features with contracts, evals, evidence, decision cards, gate decision skills (approve/signoff), a gate metrics report, runtime hooks, CI re-checks, and a coverage-scan skill (morphological-scan) feeding the contract Coverage section, and a Gate-1 gap-probe block (clean-context critique, fail-visible flags). v1.22 adds the rules ledger to pre-merge-check.sh: clean must be PROVEN — every rule block records ran/declared-off through one ledger_mark chokepoint against a fixed EXPECTED list, a machine-readable summary line whose expected count is derived from EXPECTED rather than from the running totals, and any ledger mismatch is an internal-gate error (exit 2). v1.22.1 hardening wave: declared-but-unusable scope/filter values now exit 2 as a class (empty --base/--slug, typo'd or /-containing slug filters, PRE_MERGE_BASE set-but-empty with +x set-detection, declared base on a git-less root), an explicit --base still overrides an empty env var, VIOLATION [scope] prints on stdout like every other VIOLATION. (Repo-internal maintenance tooling also hardened — sync-plugin-packages.sh rejects extra argv — but that script ships only in the kit repo, not in this package.) v1.23 renders the Gate-2 "Ngoài hợp đồng" block on the decision card: real defects that fall outside the approved scope are shown as human work with three explicit choices (known limits / new contract / widen scope), plus the coverage-cluster flag; a review-findings.md without those sections renders exactly as before. v1.24 stops an unjudged PASS at the merge boundary: a directory that CLAIMS release (evidence declaring verdict PASS, or a contract at status implemented+) can no longer be invisible to the gate — missing contract.md, risk_tier or status is now a VIOLATION instead of a silent skip, while an abandoned scaffold stays silent by design; and a human_signoff that is a placeholder rather than a name (PENDING/TBD/TODO/n/a/none/unsigned/waiting, a bare > | -, or an unfilled <...> template) is rejected, with a NOTE stating plainly that this prefix list is short and fixed so rewording is not a fix. signoff.approvers stays informational and is deliberately NOT parsed. v1.25 adds single-sourced per-section markdown boundary (lib/md-section.js). v1.26 adds the design-pass in-harness design ritual: a dedicated aesthetics+UX session on the running clickable build in the Browser pane (S1-D), with a 3-rung material ladder (real-components/scaffold/static, declared in the session note), a named DS-rule ladder (repo skill → repo tokens → shadcn default), hard token-only constraints (no new hex, no webfonts, no components/ui edits), and a state×breakpoint×theme capture note written back to the feature workspace for Gate 1. v1.27 ships references/opportunity-template.md — the discovery Cổng-0 opportunity mold with machine-readable frontmatter (OPP-FRONTMATTER-TEMPLATE marker, round-trip-tested against the kit's real frontmatter reader) and the "Nguồn ngoài & phạm vi kế thừa" inheritance-classification field (philosophy/logic inheritable; design-language/form defaults to NO — the consuming repo's standard wins, and unclassified external material blocks the Cổng-0 signature). v1.28 ships references/human-facing-language.md — the human-facing language law (N1-N6 + two quick tests + before/after examples) as an enforced reference the card, report and status renderers must load before writing a single human-facing sentence, plus two marked presentation templates: PLAN-SUMMARY-TABLE-TEMPLATE (three columns: what the user sees / what it touches / which criteria it serves) and DECISION-DIAGRAM-TEMPLATE (mermaid, triggered when a decision point has three or more sequential steps or two or more branches). The law table is byte-identical across its two homes (the enforced reference and the workflow spec) and the reviewer may reject a card at the gate, logging it to the decisions ledger as a kit defect. v1.29: hình tại điểm quyết định chọn theo mặt phẳng qua bảng tra DECISION-DIAGRAM-SURFACES, kèm phép thử nhìn-thấy-hình. /start session-entry ritual (human-typed, both harnesses locked). Bản đồ sản phẩm máy sinh + nghi thức phiên nghiệm thu (Cổng Giá trị). v1.32: thẻ nói tiếng người trọn câu — bullet Coverage/Out-of-scope hard-wrap được nối trọn dòng, khối Coverage + gap-probe nối vào tầng card-plain (key coverage_plain/gap_probe_plain, khuôn CARD-PLAIN-KEYS hai chiều), mọi fallback in text thô của contract/ledger/probe đều lột dấu markdown; sev finding vẫn do script render và overlay không giấu được hàng nào. v1.32.1 hotfix: the re-pin sha-match rule becomes an aggregate relation (every cited lane must exist with all-zero suites_exit; at least ONE cited lane must match verified_commit) — the per-section form falsely flagged every historical Re-pin section the moment a SECOND re-pin event landed. v1.33 adds judge-required-evidence: a non-PASS judge verdict must carry required_evidence[] (each item one concrete piece of evidence + where to get it; a lazy judge is exposed by the pinned marker instead of silently tolerated), the Gate-2 card renders the missing-evidence list per judgment item, the judge persona gains the actionable/no-evidence-shopping rules, and scripts/acceptance-gold.mjs derives the gold set (human decisions over machine proposals from existing Gate-2 signatures) plus the judge-agreement (G3) report consumed by /acceptance-report — purely derived, no new files. v1.38 unifies the workspace-record law: evidence-report verdict joins NAV_RULES (usesEvidence/missingArtifact), one MAP_LABELS table for product-map --check and /start (mapState), configList reads key-line comments, --root fails loud, and the UAT-COPY-PROCEDURE block makes the uat-session template copy procedure machine-extractable.

interface.longDescription: Turn feature requests into acceptance contracts, generate evals, render decision artifacts, verify machine evidence, and block unsupported PASS verdicts with Codex lifecycle hooks plus CI re-checks.
defaultPrompt: Create an acceptance contract and evals for this feature.
Verify this feature with evidence-backed acceptance gates.
